description: Credit card number validation (Luhn check), card brand detection, IMEI check. Run the Luhn checksum on a number (payment card, IMEI, many ID numbers). For card-like numbers also names the likely card brand. Format check only: it does not say the card exists or works. The number is never stored or logged. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: luhn_check
